text: Study duration 6 years, including 1 year of internship in hospital Application deadline July 31. Main Courses Covers preclinical medicine, clinical medicine and public health. Also covers biology, chemistry, immune system, pharmacy. Requirement on Chinese Language Applicants are required to pass HSK (band 3) before graduation; otherwise they cannot get the degree. Note:The requirement of the level of HSKmay be changed according to the Ministry of Education of P.R.C.. Internship Information
